brief:
Israel's security minister Itamar Ben Gvir announced the establishment of a dedicated section for death row inmates, Shehab Wire reported, marking a new step toward implementing capital punishment for Palestinian prisoners within Israeli prisons. The facility is designed to house detainees sentenced to death.

The announcement represents an advancement of Israeli legislation that would authorize execution of Palestinian detainees held in custody. The occupation government has pursued efforts to convert capital punishment laws into operational practice within the prison system, with the new wing positioned as a component of that broader policy shift.
